scope: Ten provided GD sketches inspected through current Designer builder. Research only; not copied into gallery.
limits: Rebuilt geometry changes source pin sizes/anchor and uses Designer rounded mesh gap. Results are not a validation of original colliders.
Pin angles were recovered from authored world feature positions and owners, not assumed from link endpoints.
Authored 4.55 pitch and 2.8 pin distance differ from Designer 4.5854/2.8354 defaults.

Bounded NOT FOUND does not prove every continuous route impossible. A nonempty active directed cycle of only rings has an invariant outgoing lock at each vertex here: no member can rotate; without a bomb/Booster or externally movable member the internal contacts cannot change.
No interpretation of GD sketch numbers as campaign order or aesthetic/difficulty labels.
